units.source_text: 父亲显然很担心自己的病。

en.t: Father was clearly very worried about his own illness.

units.source_text: 但是，医生每次前来问诊，父亲都没有问什么难为医生的问题。

en.t: However, whenever the doctor came to examine him, Father never asked any awkward questions that would trouble the doctor.

units.source_text: 医生也有所顾忌，从没说过什么。

en.t: The doctor, too, was cautious and never said anything definite.

units.source_text: 父亲似乎在考虑他死后的事情，

en.t: Father seemed to be thinking about what would happen after his death,

units.source_text: 至少在想象自己去世后的这个家。

en.t: or at least imagining this household after he was gone.

units.source_text: “让孩子去上大学也好也不好，

en.t: Sending a child to university has its good and bad sides,

units.source_text: 好不容易供他大学毕了业，他就绝对不回家了。

en.t: after you go to all the trouble of putting him through university, he absolutely refuses to come home.

units.source_text: 这不就像是为了让父子分离才送孩子去上大学的吗？”

en.t: Isn't that just like sending a child to university for the sake of separating father and son?

units.source_text: 哥哥上大学的结果，就是远走他乡。

en.t: The result of my elder brother going to university was that he went far away from home.

units.source_text: 我也因为受了教育，而决心在东京生活。

en.t: I too, because I had received an education, had resolved to live in Tokyo.

units.source_text: 培养出这样的儿子，父亲发发牢骚当然不是没有道理。

en.t: Since he had raised sons like this, Father's complaints were naturally not without reason.

units.source_text: 父亲想象着母亲孤孤单单地留在这座老旧的农舍里，会多么孤独。

en.t: Father imagined how lonely Mother would be, left all by herself in this old farmhouse.

units.source_text: 父亲相信自己的家是不会发生变化的，

en.t: Father believed that his own home would never change,

units.source_text: 住在这里的母亲只要还活着，也是不会离开的。

en.t: and that Mother, who lived there, would not leave it as long as she was alive.

units.source_text: 父亲心里很矛盾，虽然为自己死后，剩下母亲孤零零地留在这所空寂的家中感到深深的不安，却又想让我在东京谋个好职位。

en.t: There was a contradiction in Father's heart: although he felt deeply uneasy about leaving Mother all alone in that empty house after his death, he still wanted me to find a good position in Tokyo.

units.source_text: 我觉得他这矛盾心理很可笑，

en.t: I found this contradiction in him amusing,

units.source_text: 同时又为因此能去东京而感到高兴。

en.t: and at the same time I was glad that because of it I could go to Tokyo.
